newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends lower, led by July on liquidation.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends lower, led by July on liquidation.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended lower on Thursday, led by July on long liquidation ahead of expiry on July 22, traders said.
"The tone was set by the July," a pit source said. "We saw a lot of outright liquidation of the July."
New crop months escaped the brunt of the sell-off with support tied to mounting concerns that dry weather would damage rice crops from India to China.
Traders pointed to news erratic weather patterns in Thailand will force farmers to change crop planting schedules and habits.
The government advised farmers to delay rice plantings until August after an unusually long dry spell.
"The market cannot afford to have a monsoon problem," a veteran rice trader said.
Rice ended down 24 to two cents per cwt with July off 24 at $10.91. Volume was estimated by CBOT at 550 lots, compared with Wednesday's actual volume of 608.
